title: Annotation alignment: Comparing LLM and human annotations of conversational safety

bias_targets.methodology: Computing Pearson correlations between LLM safety annotations and the average safety ratings of different racial annotator subgroups (Asian, Black, Latinx, Multiracial, White) to assess alignment disparities. Also evaluated by prompting the LLM to predict which racial group found a conversation more unsafe.

Computing Pearson correlations between LLM safety annotations and the average safety ratings of different gender annotator subgroups (Female, Male) to evaluate if the model's safety judgments disproportionately align with a particular gender.
